caption: The drawing depicts a metallic armored gauntlet in a fist position, with a single upward-pointing index finger. The gauntlet is rendered in shades of gray and silver to suggest a metallic surface, with detailed shading to emphasize the contours and joints of the fingers and hand. The wrist of the gauntlet features a frilled, decorative cuff, also in muted gray tones with highlights added to create a dimensional effect. The background of the drawing is a plain off-white or beige color, with no other objects or designs present. The artist's signature, "h. schulze," appears in small writing to the left below the gauntlet.
title: Pipe Stand
